entries.text: The commotion subsides. The white sheep stays close, its ornate scroll still within reach, and looks from one person to another with an unmistakably expectant air.

entries.title: Guz leads the three collared wolves and the cloaked figure away with…
entries.text: Guz leads the three collared wolves and the cloaked figure away with Finethir toward Noke's home; his demand had been to return the sheep to his master.

entries.title: Howling, angry shouts, and an occasional scream draw nearer
entries.text: Howling, angry shouts, and an occasional scream draw nearer. A hulking half-orc pushes through the crowd with one hand on a greatsword. Three large wolves wear iron collars; behind him, a huge cloaked figure's heavy footfalls rise above the commotion. The half-orc fixes his small eyes on the sheep and says, “That sheep is Master Noke’s... he desires to have it back.”

entries.title: The sheep's bleating changes into cultured Common with an elven accent…
entries.text: The sheep's bleating changes into cultured Common with an elven accent and a slight bleat. He introduces himself as Finethir Shinebright, says he is a wizard in dire need of aid, and begins asking for help recovering a powerful artifact from a dangerous wizard—but hasn't finished his story yet.
